creator: Alexander Terp
description: In a 940 pt window with four side-by-side panes, a blocked pane's header showed `is...` for the callsign and `Bloc` for the state word, cut at the header's edge with no ellipsis. The callsign truncates properly; the state word should too, or give way before the callsign does. Seen in a stand-in window screenshot after the redesign landed.
title: A narrow pane header clips its state word without an ellipsis
